idea: Animals & their sounds #3 (SUNNY PARK, at the duck pond, Jimmy in OUTDOOR outfit sitting on the grass beside a low flat grey stone): hook 'Wow! Who says quack?' – a little white duck pops up out of the pond onto the stone right beside Jimmy, splashing, and he gasps; 'Quack, quack, quack! The little duck!'; a little green FROG on the stone: 'Ribbit, ribbit! The little frog!' + copy-me 'Hop, hop, hop! Hop with me!'; a little blue BIRD lands on the stone: 'Tweet, tweet, tweet! The little bird!' + copy-me 'Flap, flap, flap! Flap with me!' (Jimmy flaps his arms like wings); all three in a neat row, Jimmy points at the frog and asks the viewer 'Who says ribbit? Hmm?' (2 s humming pause) – 'The frog! Yay!'; review 'Quack, ribbit, tweet! Sing with me!'. Loop: the hook framing again, duck, frog and bird in a row on the stone, bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! Who Says Quack? 🦆 Animal Sounds with Baby Jimmy | Duck, Frog, Bird | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A little duck pops out of the pond right beside Baby Jimmy in Sunny Park! 🦆 Sing along with Jimmy and learn what the duck, the frog and the bird say – then help him answer: who says ribbit?

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Who says quack?" – quack, quack, quack! The little duck!
🐸 Ribbit, ribbit! The little frog! Hop, hop, hop! Hop with me!
🐦 Tweet, tweet, tweet! The little bird! Flap, flap, flap! Flap with me!
🤔 "Who says ribbit?" – can you say it? THE FROG! Yay!
👋 Quack, ribbit, tweet! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: animal sounds for toddlers • duck – quack • frog – ribbit • bird – tweet • hop and flap along

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun animal sounds song for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Jimmy sits by the duck pond in Sunny Park, meets a little duck, a little frog and a little bird, sings their sounds, hops like a frog, flaps like a bird and asks you which animal says ribbit. After watching, can you quack, ribbit and tweet with Jimmy?
